deliberation: Pass metadata: reviewer_system_id=openai-gpt-5.6-sol; logical_pass_id=GI-COUNCIL-INDEPENDENT-CONTRIBUTOR-INTAKE-001/referee/read-only-v1; mode=non_authoring_read_only; exact_subject=matter_sha256:6f1280f8c7bdfd9195f266077666fe54270efe0b1a721a33c92614a99b9c2130. Full quorum identifies no reason to reject the conceptual separation. The offices converge on a bounded pilot with stricter definitions and machine/review boundaries. The critical corrections are: treat independence as evidence-qualified rather than inferred; make raw intake append-only and content-addressed; separate deterministic byte/dispatch/freshness checks from semantic duplicate judgments; define blind-cohort closure and late-return semantics; quarantine executable payloads; and preserve Human Steward and protected-admission authority. The proposal should therefore advance as ready with conditions, not as immediate organization-wide policy.
discharged_obligations: Reconciled all differentiated office findings into one bounded pilot disposition.
Preserved the distinction between Council advice, Human Steward authority, mathematical adjudication, and protected incorporation.
Checked that the conditions address executor concurrency and integrity feedback without imposing GCL internal mutation duties on external contributors.
findings: All ten offices support the contributor/intake/adjudication separation subject to pilot conditions.
The most important concurrency defect is race-dependent cohort synthesis; explicit closure semantics repair it.
The most important integrity defect is overclaiming machine-detectable independence or semantic duplication; those remain evidence-qualified review judgments.
The pilot can test the protocol without creating a new claim authority plane.
conditions: Pilot only: do not activate an organization-wide mandatory intake policy or persistent coordinator from this matter.

Represent independence with separate declared-context, authenticated-provenance-when-available, and adjudicated-independence fields; never infer independence from session/model/file identifiers alone.
Preserve every raw contribution and attachment immutably by exact content identity before normalization, synthesis, or adjudication; corrections are new linked records.

Automate only mechanically decidable classifications such as byte identity, exact dispatch binding, schema validity, explicit supersession links, and observable freshness. Semantic duplication, plagiarism, conflict meaning, and independence strength remain review-bound.

Define concurrency modes cooperative_claimed, independent_blind, and adversarial_replay, with explicit blind-cohort membership/closure. No cross-contribution synthesis before durable cohort closure; late returns remain preserved evidence with explicit late status.
Treat contributor payloads as untrusted data. Embedded instructions and executable attachments cannot trigger actions without a separate authorized sandboxed execution path.
Keep the inbox proposal-only and non-canonical. Protected dependency consumption requires ordinary exact-digest adjudication and the existing MATHSOLVE/MATHCERT/governance route.

Pilot receipts must bind dispatch identity, raw digest, attachment digests, declared context/provenance, concurrency mode, freshness, schema result, and handling state, and support idempotent replay without overwrite.

Run hostile fixtures for identifier collision, same bytes/different dispatch, different bytes/same identifier, stale live state, truncated return, blind-cohort contamination, duplicate attachment, late return, malicious embedded instruction, and transport replay.

Return pilot evidence, executor feedback, schema/validator proposal, and measured overhead to full Council review before broader institutionalization; final activation remains subject to Human Steward authority.
residual_uncertainty: The long-term location of organization-wide contribution storage, authenticated identity model, and any MATH-CORE external-proposal representation remain open beyond the pilot.
The pilot will not establish philosophical or statistical independence between contributors; it will only preserve and expose the available provenance conditions.
